We currently have the sections [V14.6 Web or Application Server Configuration](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/72a27eeb4e3019d2bff257ced1a9f93e78b6ec04/5.0/en/0x22-V14-Config.md#v146-web-or-application-server-configuration) and [V14.7 External Service Configuration](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/72a27eeb4e3019d2bff257ced1a9f93e78b6ec04/5.0/en/0x22-V14-Config.md#v147-external-service-configuration)

Practically speaking, the requirements in both are similar and relate to how the application communicates.

I propose that they should be merged.
